script_text: Aries, this week turns pressure into power; one rushed message could reopen doors. From Monday to Wednesday, Mercury in your 7th House opposes Pluto in your 11th, stressing contracts, group messages, and money terms; Wednesday is best for verification, Monday is worst for impulsive promises. Mars, the fiery ruler of Aries, occupies your 11th House, conjunct Pluto, intensifying clear public visibility. Midweek, the Sun enters your 7th House, focusing clients, partners, and negotiations. By Thursday through Sunday, the Sun sextiles Uranus in your 3rd, bringing freelance ideas and faster payment. On September 26, the Full Moon in your 7th House opens a love conversation. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun sextiles Uranus in your 3rd. Monday is your worst day because Mercury's opposition to Pluto can turn messages into financial disputes. Put agreements, fees, and promises in writing. Follow for daily updates.
